content.summary: Getting to know the Bachelor of Science in Midwifery Class of 2020

media.alt: Supporting Regional Midwives through Skills Upgrade

content.text: In February 2018, the AKU-SONAM campus in Nairobi, Kenya got licensed by the Commission of University Education to begin offering the Bachelor of Science in Midwifery course. This undergraduate, upskilling degree officially opened its doors at the beginning of August 2018 and the first cohort finished their first semester in December 2018.

The introduction and delivery of this course is made possible through the support of the German Development Bank (KfW) and the German Federal Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). At AKU-SONAM we believe in empowering regional nurses and midwives in order to bring frontline healthcare professionals and the communities they serve closer to achieving universal health coverage.

In the coming weeks, we will share some profiles of the brave trainee midwives from Kisii who have enrolled in the inaugural BScM course here in Nairobi. This being the inaugural class you can also look out for their reflections on their first semester in our upcoming edition of the SONAM Newsletter at the end of March 2019.
